content.text: The digital product economy is structurally unfair to creators in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — Stripe for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-complete-infrastructure|payment]]s, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-what-actually-how-3|COREMERCH guide to crypto]]-what-actually-how-7|Automated Digital]] delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-7. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after a crypto payment involves a system where digital products are dispatched automatically upon transaction confirmation, eliminating manual processes. This system is crucial for creators in regions such as Nigeria or Zimbabwe, where traditional payment processors are not viable. By leveraging decentralized payment methods, these creators can maintain control and reduce costs, allowing them to focus on their content rather than the payment hurdles.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of various components that work together to facilitate automated delivery. Platforms like Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, while NOWPayments provides crypto payment processing. Upon payment confirmation, a webhook triggers the delivery system, ensuring that the ebook is sent immediately to the buyer's email. This infrastructure supports multiple cryptocurrencies, allowing creators to cater to a global audience without incurring high fees from traditional payment gateways.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators who have been locked out of conventional payment systems. Whether you're selling ebooks, online courses, or digital assets like templates and fonts, the automated delivery system empowers you to transact directly with buyers. It's particularly beneficial for those in countries facing economic instability or sanctions, offering an alternative that is both reliable and cost-effective.
Automated delivery means your ebooks reach buyers instantly after payment.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this system include hosting services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend solutions through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets. Combined with NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, these tools form a cohesive stack that enables creators to build their own online stores. The infrastructure ensures that creators retain full ownership of their data and transactions, unlike traditional platforms that impose fees and restrictions.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To implement this system, start by selecting your hosting service from GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you choose low-fee networks like BSC or Solana for cost efficiency. Finally, link your order storage solution to manage customer data effectively. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all the necessary blueprints and templates.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
With NOWPayments, you keep 99.5% of your sales, unlike platforms that take 10%.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit includes all six blueprints and seven templates necessary to build a sovereign digital commerce stack, designed specifically for creators facing payment restrictions.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
